basics.name: Bowen Du
basics.label: Undergraduate Researcher in Medical Image Reconstruction
basics.summary: An undergraduate student at Sichuan University majoring in Artificial Intelligence, ranked top 10 in the department, with research experience in deep learning-based CBCT reconstruction and medical imaging.

work.name: Sichuan University, Hu Junjie’s Group
work.summary: Conducting research on CBCT reconstruction using deep learning techniques, including Transformer-CNN hybrids and advanced encoding methods.
highlights: Applied loss-based innovation for CBCT reconstruction.
Participated in multi-dataset experiments with LUNA16, CQ500, and West China Hospital clinical data.

awards.title: National Second Prize - Huawei ICT Competition (Ascend AI Track)
awards.summary: Awarded for outstanding performance in AI model optimization and application on the Ascend AI platform.

publications.name: A Sparse CBCT 3D Reconstruction Framework with Enhanced Global Information
publications.summary: This research introduces an innovative loss design for improved volumetric reconstruction from sparse CBCT projections.

projects.name: Deep Learning-Based CBCT Reconstruction
projects.summary: Developed a CBCT reconstruction pipeline incorporating random sampling, volume block division, and multiple loss strategies.
highlights: Implemented Chamfer Distance, MSE, and custom loss functions.
Experimented with clinical and public datasets.
